interaction.action: Tapped the manual Refresh control once, then inspected the resulting on-device view.

overview_response.observation: The response repeated the retrieval timestamp already displayed before the tap. The app retained the view and displayed Market data needs attention with a same-timestamp freshness warning.

scope_and_limits: This is one local development session on one Xiaomi Android device.
It verifies the displayed chart refresh and same-timestamp overview warning, not the freshness or accuracy of CoinGecko upstream data.
The overview, chart and sample timestamps are per-resource and are not synchronized.
The installed APK is an existing debug artifact; Metro supplied the updated JavaScript. No reinstall, new build, release APK, hosted route or customer login was verified.
No signed-in account, wallet balance, portfolio holding, contact, payment or customer record was accessed.
